name: Default
shortDescription: All-in-one project management platform with issue tracking, documents, chat and planner, backed by CockroachDB, Elasticsearch, Redpanda and S3 storage.

alerts.message: Huly is resource-heavy: upstream recommends at least 2 vCPUs and 8 GB of RAM for the whole stack.
Sign-up is open to anyone who can reach the URL. Create your account and workspace first, then set DISABLE_SIGNUP=true on the account and front services to allow only invited users.
